_about: REFERENCE ONLY. Every site_config.json setting this app reads, with dummy values. Copy the keys you need into sites/<site>/site_config.json and put the real values there. Never put real keys or tokens in this file. When you add, rename or remove a setting in the code, update this file in the same commit. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored by the app.

enable_ai_assistant._comment_providers: ai_provider_chat answers chat questions. ai_provider_image reads uploaded images and PDFs (it falls back to the chat provider when missing). Providers: gemini, claude, deepseek, openrouter, kimi, glm, bedrock. The *_model keys name the model; leave them out to use the provider's own default.
enable_ai_assistant._comment_keys: Each provider takes a list of keys. With 2 or more keys a failing key is skipped for the next one: Gemini on any error, Claude and DeepSeek (also OpenRouter, Kimi, GLM) on rate-limit or rejected-key errors. Keys from different provider projects give separate quotas.
enable_ai_assistant._comment_optional_models: Optional. gemini_model is used when no ai_provider_*_model names a Gemini model. gemini_timeout_sec is how long one Gemini call may take.
enable_ai_assistant._comment_extra_params: Optional. Extra options sent with every request to that provider, for example {"reasoning_effort": "medium"} to lower DeepSeek's thinking. Empty means the built-in defaults (thinking on, effort high).
enable_ai_assistant._comment_pdf: Optional. Only needed to read PDFs with DeepSeek: path to the python of the separate Docling virtualenv, and a time limit in seconds (keep it at 90 or less, bench's web timeout is usually 120). Without it a PDF sent to DeepSeek shows a 'can read photos but not PDF files' message.
enable_ai_assistant._comment_header_color: Optional. Chat header color as a hex code (6 or 3 digits, the # may be left out). Missing or invalid means the default blue shown here.
enable_ai_assistant._comment_mcp_base_url: Leave empty to use this site's own URL (normal). Only set it when the MCP server (frappe_assistant_core) runs on another site, for example https://other-site.example.com
enable_ai_assistant._comment_speech: Optional voice input. The mic button shows only when enable_speech_to_text is 1 and a Sarvam key is set.
enable_ai_assistant._comment_roles: Optional role based access. When enable_role_based_ai is 1, a user's chat uses the token of the role they have; each token is 'api_key:api_secret' of a user that has the access that role should get. Leave it 0 to use each user's own API key.

_comment_bedrock: Optional. Only when ai_provider_chat or ai_provider_image is bedrock (AWS).
_comment_sitemap: Optional. How long the generated sitemap is cached, in seconds (default 300).
_comment_whatsapp: Optional fallback only. The WhatsApp auth token is normally read from WhatsApp Settings in the UI; this key is used when that is empty.
_comment_credit_limit: Optional. People who must not get the credit limit email even if they are credit controllers.
_comment_host: Standard Frappe setting, also used by the OTP feature to build links.
